new.text: The Copernicus European Regional Reanalysis (CERRA) provides atmospheric reanalysis data over Europe at a horizontal resolution of 5.5~km, offering finer spatial detail than the global ERA5 reanalysis \citep{ridal2024cerra}. Although \citet{ridal2024cerra} reported improvements over ERA5 for several near-surface variables, the present study uses ERA5 for both predictors and target precipitation and does not assess whether CERRA would improve regional precipitation forecasting.
